name: softcap_inplace_logits
description: Apply final-logit softcapping in place with signature softcap_inplace_logits(full_logits, final_logit_softcapping) -> torch.Tensor. For a floating-point tensor, the entire buffer is treated as flat and each element is updated to cap * tanh(x / cap), evaluated in float32 as (2 * sigmoid(2 * x / cap) - 1) * cap and stored back in the input dtype, where cap = float(final_logit_softcapping). The function mutates full_logits and returns that same tensor; the Torch reference is out-of-place and returns a new tensor, so the correctness test clones the candidate input. Non-contiguous input is capped through a contiguous temporary and then copied back. An empty tensor is returned unchanged. cap is expected to be nonzero. The current correctness and benchmark suites exercise contiguous float32 inputs of shape [m, n] with cap=30.0; shapes include [1, 17], [37, 1024], [4, 32000], and larger [m, n] cases up to n=128256.
